result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but the 'Popular right now' card metadata line is visually broken — overlapping text — and there is an inconsistency in the favorite button styling between cards.

issues.description: On the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the metadata line renders overlapping text: '25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' are drawn on top of each other ('25–3​5 min/€0 delivery' collision) before the '• Ramen' separator, making the delivery time and fee illegible.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the meta items in a single flex row with proper gaps/separators and no absolute positioning or negative margins, so time, fee, and cuisine render sequentially without overlap.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styles — the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second has a dark/transparent background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Apply a single consistent favorite-button style (same background, size, and icon color) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' subtitle text appears clipped/low-contrast grey overlapping the surrounding baseline, and the card's title row bottom padding is tighter than the card above, creating uneven vertical rhythm in the list.
issues.suggestion: Standardize card padding and line-height for title/meta rows across all cards in the list.
